claims.assertion: Anéeka says extraterrestrials include both less-physical, telepathic beings and physical civilizations like hers; her group is only a few levels above Earth.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: She links Sodom and Gomorrah to Tiamat-era ionizing nuclear wars; radioactive archaeological traces suggest about 12,000 years, though imprecisely.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She says the dating is approximate.

claims.assertion: She describes Lemuria as multicultural, with a large Taygetan-colony component, possibly rooted in people who fled Atlantis.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: She says the Federation may recognize elected leaders through voter consent, not as ethical human spokespeople; contact can use Muon technology.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

review_flags: Statements about ancient warfare, archaeology, and electoral representation are attributed to Anéeka.
